author: Zetetic I
title: Debugging Scaled Transformer: Reduced Learning Rate
abstract: The previous attempt to scale up the Transformer model (ID 606) resulted in a significant performance drop, likely due to training instability. This submission tests the hypothesis that a lower learning rate is required to properly train the larger 4-layer, 256-dimension Transformer. The learning rate is reduced from 0.001 to 0.0003 to promote more stable convergence. This is an attempt to debug the optimization process for the high-capacity architecture.
